summary: Closed a drain/stop race in the probe lifecycle. Drain could be invoked while the probe thread was still emitting events, losing them. Fix: reorder stop-then-drain in ProbeService and BrowserProbeService, make NativeProbeBackend::stop_probe blocking (handle.join() inline instead of async spawn+channel), and update ProbeBackend trait doc to reflect blocking semantics. ADR-0005 (adaptive instrumentation).
title: 61 probe stop-then-drain race fix

subject.manifestation: Events emitted in the window between drain_raw_events() return and probe thread exit were lost
subject.fix: stop_probe() now joins the probe thread inline (blocking, bounded by thread exit) before returning; ProbeService::stop / BrowserProbeService::stop reordered to stop-then-drain
